fieldValues.title: Site author in Evidence-backed writing
fieldValues.summary: The owner writing a public website, where every statement must be backed by evidence and agents may draft copy freely. The owner owns the words over time: agent drafts reach the page only when the owner swaps them in, and editing makes them the owner's. Distinct from the essay writer, who wants no agent drafting.
goals: Every statement on the site can be backed by a claim, a source or our own content
Agents draft freely, but nothing reaches the page unseen
The page's words become the owner's own over time
Start from what is live, not from a blank page or placeholders
jobs: Build and rearrange a page from the site's blocks
Back each sentence with a claim and see the claim's warrant and overstatement
Compare an agent's alternative with the current block and swap one in
Hand an agent the page and its unbacked sentences
fieldValues.needs: Sentence-level evidence on the page itself, alternatives kept beside each block, and a visible record of whose words are on the page.
